circle.data-action: check:["REL-0017","ios","pro-hr-zone",["TST-0647"],"From resting heart rate, ride HR Z4 Threshold 3×8min, then a Zone Ride. Read stripes, labels and trace. Discard both.",["TST-0647"],[{"text":"From rest, the trace shows at once, in the bottom band from 73 to 113 bpm. The band is labelled `<Z1`, not `Z0`.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"As HR climbs from about 90 to 113, the trace rises about 9% of the height.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"Below 73 bpm the trace sits on the bottom edge. Above Z5 it sits on the top edge, in red.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"The Z2 target reads 129–144, and the Z2 stripe has the same two edges.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"At about 136 bpm the trace sits inside the Z2 stripe, in the Z2 colour.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"Above 144 the line turns red at the stripe's top edge.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"Six bpm labels run down the left edge, zone names down the right, each matching its band's target. None is skipped.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]},{"text":"The same holds on the Zone Ride screen.","tags":["TST-0647"],"passed":[]}],false]
